items.example: The letters -ar are not a meaning bearing suffix in poplar.
items.exampleCN: poplar 里的 -ar 并不是表示意义的词尾。

items.meaning: a smooth light fabric, from French
items.meaningCN: 一种光滑轻薄的面料，来自法语
items.example: Poplin looks like poplar but is a different word.
items.exampleCN: poplin 与 poplar 形近，却是另一个词。

latinEntries.example: Populus is the classical Latin tree name.
latinEntries.exampleCN: populus 是古典拉丁语的树名。

latinEntries.example: Populeus describes things made of poplar wood.
latinEntries.exampleCN: populeus 描述用杨木制成的东西。

definition_zh: 平民百姓；民众；全体居民
definition_en: the ordinary people who live in a country or area, taken as a whole
core_image: 广场上乌压压挤成一片的普通人，没有名字，只是一个整体
scene: 选举那天，广场上挤满了普通市民，他们排着长队等待投票。On election day the square was crowded with a restless populace waiting to vote.
sceneCN: 这里 populace 是「平民百姓」（第 1 个义项：被当作一个整体的普通人）；句意：选举那天广场挤满躁动的民众，排队等着投票。

pos.zh: 平民百姓；民众；全体居民

derivatives.zh: 由民众之义加形容词后缀构成，义为「受大众喜爱的；流行的」
由民众之义加名词后缀构成，义为「人口；全体居民」
与民众同源，义为「人口稠密的」

senses.title: The common people as a whole
senses.definition: the ordinary people of a place, spoken of as one mass rather than as individuals
senses.definitionCN: 一个地方的普通人，被当作一个整体而不是一个个个体来谈论
senses.example: The new tax was deeply unpopular with the ordinary populace.
senses.exampleCN: 这项新税很不受普通民众欢迎。
senses.why: The Latin root means the people, and the mass body sense keeps that bare collective meaning, without counting anyone.
senses.whyCN: 词根本义就是「人民」，大众群体义保留了这种整体的集合含义，并不清点具体人数。

senses.title: The lowest classes of a town
senses.definition: the poorer lower classes of a town, viewed from above as a separate group
senses.definitionCN: 城镇中较贫穷的下层阶级，被上层视角单独看作一群人
senses.example: In old comedies the populace was mocked for its rough manners.
senses.exampleCN: 在旧时的喜剧里，市井小民常因举止粗鲁而被嘲笑。
senses.why: Once a crowd is seen from above, it becomes a class rather than a whole people, and the word carries a faint social ranking.
senses.whyCN: 一旦从高处俯视人群，他们就从「全体人民」变成了一个阶层，这个词也带上了淡淡的社会分层意味。

senses.title: Everyone living in a place
senses.definition: all the residents of a town or state, considered without regard to class
senses.definitionCN: 一个城镇或国家的全体居民，不分阶层一并视为整体
senses.example: The plague reached every level of the city populace.
senses.exampleCN: 瘟疫波及了这座城市各个阶层的居民。
senses.why: The old mass sense can widen again to cover residents in general, once class distinctions are ignored.
senses.whyCN: 当不再区分阶层时，旧的「整体人群」义又能扩展为泛指全体居民。

intro.en: Populace comes from Italian popolo and Latin populus, the people, through the same root that gives popular and population.
intro.cn: populace 经由意大利语 popolo 与拉丁语 populus（人民）而来，与 popular、population 同一词根。

items.en: Populus means the people, the whole citizen body.
items.cn: populus 意为人民，即全体公民。

items.en: Italian popolo names the people of a town.
items.cn: 意大利语 popolo 指城镇的人民。

items.en: French populace refers to a crowd of common people.
items.cn: 法语 populace 指一群普通人。

items.en: Early English writers borrow the word to mean the common people.
items.cn: 早期英语作者借用此词表示普通百姓。

items.en: Prose and journalism keep the word slightly formal and collective.
items.cn: 散文与新闻写作让这个词保持稍正式、偏集合的用法。

note.en: Populace is the collective noun of the Latin people word, so it sits close to population, popular and populist, and next to ordinary words for the public.
note.cn: populace 是拉丁语「人民」的集合名词，因此与 population、popular、populist 相邻，也与一般的「大众」词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who claims to speak for the common people
entries.definitionCN: 自称代表平民发声的人

entries.definition: liked by many people
entries.definitionCN: 受大众喜爱的

entries.definition: having many people living in it
entries.definitionCN: 人口稠密的（与 populace 同音但不同词）

entries.definition: all the citizens of a place taken together
entries.definitionCN: 全体公民；市民（偏正式，强调公民身份）

entries.definition: the large number of ordinary people
entries.definitionCN: 群众；大众（多带阶级意味）

entries.definition: people in general, seen as an audience or community
entries.definitionCN: 公众；大众（偏向作为受众的公众）

normalIntro.en: Populace keeps the bare Latin idea of the people, and the ending -ace marks it as one whole crowd rather than a list of persons.
normalIntro.cn: populace 保留了拉丁语「人民」的原义，结尾 -ace 让它读起来像一整群人，而不是一串个人。

normal.en: The root populus means people, so populace is the people taken as a single body.
normal.cn: 词根 populus 意为人民，所以 populace 是把人民当作一个整体。

normal.en: The general populace means ordinary people rather than leaders or experts.
normal.cn: the general populace 指普通人，而不是领袖或专家。

normal.en: Do not confuse populace with populous, which means densely peopled.
normal.cn: 注意别把 populace 和 populous 混淆，后者意为「人口稠密的」。

normal.en: A populace can be restless, angry or contented, but it is almost never just one person.
normal.cn: populace 可以躁动、愤怒或满足，但几乎从不指单独一个人。

normal.en: Compare citizenry and the masses: populace sounds formal and neutral, the masses often sounds political.
normal.cn: 对比 citizenry 与 the masses：populace 正式而中性，the masses 常带政治色彩。

abstract.en: Picture a sea of heads in a square, each face too small to name.
abstract.cn: 想象广场上一片人头攒动，每张脸都小到看不清。

abstract.en: Think of a town crier shouting news to a balcony and the crowd below.
abstract.cn: 想象一名公告员对着阳台和下面的众人高喊消息。

abstract.en: See an old map where tiny houses stand for every resident inside them.
abstract.cn: 想象一张旧地图，每座小房子代表屋里的每一位居民。

examples.en: The campaign tried to win over the rural populace.
examples.cn: 这场竞选试图争取乡村民众的支持。

examples.en: News of the scandal spread quickly through the local populace.
examples.cn: 丑闻的消息迅速在本地民众中传开。

examples.en: A literate populace is essential to a healthy democracy.
examples.cn: 有文化的民众对健康的民主制度至关重要。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「怕普拉斯」——一群普通人挤在广场上，人多得怕普拉斯都装不下；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 populus（人民）→ 意大利语 popolo → 法语 populace → 英语 populace，核心义是作为整体的人群。

sensesIntro.en: Populace begins as the bare collective idea of the people, then narrows to the lower classes of a town, and can widen again to all residents.
sensesIntro.cn: populace 起初只指作为整体的「人民」，随后缩窄为城镇的下层平民，又可能重新扩展为全体居民。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a faceless crowd packed into a square.
core.cn: 核心意象：广场上挤成一片、看不清面孔的人群。

branches.en: The ordinary crowd is the central modern sense.
branches.cn: 普通大众是核心的现代义项。

branches.en: The lower class sense carries an old social ranking.
branches.cn: 下层平民义带着旧式社会分层。

branches.en: The resident sense covers a whole place.
branches.cn: 全体居民义覆盖一整个地方。

branches.en: Both the common people and all residents are groups, not individuals.
branches.cn: 平民与居民都是群体，而不是个人。

branches.en: A pestilence or a tax affects every layer of the populace.
branches.cn: 瘟疫或税负会影响到民众的每一个阶层。

intro.en: Populace is built on the Latin stem popul, the people, plus an Italian and French ending that makes it a single mass noun.
intro.cn: populace 由拉丁词干 popul（人民）加上意大利语、法语化的结尾构成，使它成为一个表示整体的名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin populus means the people, and the same stem grows popular, population, populous and populace.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 populus 意为人民，同一词干长出了 popular、population、populous 与 populace。

items.example: The Latin stem popul sits in every member of this family.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁词干 popul 出现在这一词族的每个词里。

items.meaning: not a productive suffix, but the Italian and French ending behind the word
items.meaningCN: 并非能产的后缀，而是词尾携来的意法式结尾
items.example: The ending -ace gives populace its single whole shape.
items.exampleCN: 结尾 -ace 让 populace 成为不可数的整体名词。

items.example: Populace stays a whole body of people.
items.exampleCN: populace 始终指作为整体的人群。

items.example: Popular adds the meaning of being liked.
items.exampleCN: popular 增加了「被喜爱」的意思。

items.meaning: the people living in a place
items.example: Population turns the people into a countable figure.
items.exampleCN: population 把人民变成可计数的规模。

items.example: Populous describes a crowded place.
items.exampleCN: populous 描述人多的地方。

items.meaning: a politics that claims to serve the people
items.example: Populism appeals directly to the people.
items.exampleCN: populism 直接诉诸人民。

items.meaning: to fill a place with people
items.example: Populate makes the people a verb of filling.
items.exampleCN: populate 让「人民」变成填充的动词。

items.meaning: to empty a place of people
items.example: Depopulate adds a prefix meaning away.
items.exampleCN: depopulate 加上了表示「离开」的前缀。

latinEntries.example: Populus is the source of this word family.
latinEntries.exampleCN: populus 是这一词族的源头。

latinEntries.example: Italian popolo carries the word into the Romance languages.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 意大利语 popolo 把这个词带入罗曼语族。

latinEntries.example: French populace lies behind the English spelling.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 法语 populace 促成了英语的拼写。

definition_zh: 居住于；构成……的人口；使有人居住；填充；输入（数据）
definition_en: to live in a place and fill it with people, or to fill something with items, such as data in a list
core_image: 一块空荡荡的土地上，一个接一个冒出了人的身影
scene: 开发团队给空地盖好了房子，几年后那里住进了几千户人家。Developers built homes on the empty land, and within a few years thousands of families had populated the district.
sceneCN: 这里 populate 是「使有人居住、住满」（第 1 个义项：人们住进一个地方，把地方填满）；句意：开发商在空地上建了房，几年间就有几千户人家住满了这个区。

pos.zh: 居住于；构成……的人口；使有人居住

derivatives.zh: 由 populate 加名词后缀构成，义为「人口；居民」
由过去分词形容词化，义为「有人居住的；人口为……的」
由前缀 de-（去除）加 populate 构成，义为「使人口减少」
与 populate 同源，义为「人口稠密的」

senses.title: To live in and fill a place
senses.definition: to live in a place as a group so that the place is filled with people
senses.definitionCN: 一群人住在一个地方，使那里有了人烟、被住满
senses.example: Settlers populated the valley within a single generation.
senses.exampleCN: 移民们在一代人之内就住满了这个山谷。
senses.why: The Latin root means the people, so the verb turns a whole people into an action of filling up a space.
senses.whyCN: 词根本义是「人民」，动词化之后就把一群人民变成「把一个空间填满」的动作。

senses.title: To form the population of
senses.definition: to be the people who make up the population of a place or group
senses.definitionCN: 作为某个地方或群体的居民，构成它的人口
senses.example: Students populate the city centre every September.
senses.exampleCN: 每年九月，学生就构成了市中心的人口主力。
senses.why: The same filling picture works from the other side, so the inhabitants are described as populating the place rather than being filled into it.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「填满」图景也可以反过来看：说的是居民「构成为」那里的人口，而不是被塞进去。

senses.title: To fill with items or data
senses.definition: to put information, objects or characters into a list, form, database or game world
senses.definitionCN: 把信息、物品或角色填入清单、表格、数据库或游戏世界
senses.example: The script populates the table with clean, verified records.
senses.exampleCN: 这个脚本用经过核对的记录填充表格。
senses.why: The people who filled a place are replaced by records, items or game characters, so any container can be populated in computing.
senses.whyCN: 填满地方的「人」被记录、物品或游戏角色取代，所以计算机领域里任何容器都可以被填充。

intro.en: Populate is a verb built on Latin populus, the people, through a medieval Latin verb meaning to lay waste or to people, and into English in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: populate 是以拉丁语 populus（人民）为基础的动词，经中世纪拉丁语中一度表示「荒废、安置居民」的动词进入现代英语。

items.en: Populus means the people, the body of citizens.
items.cn: populus 意为人民，即公民整体。

items.en: Populare is recorded in both a destructive and a peopling sense.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 populare 同时有「毁坏」与「安置居民」两种记录。

items.en: Populate first appears in English in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: populate 于十六世纪首次出现在英语中。

items.en: The peopling sense takes over, and the destructive sense fades.
items.cn: 「使有人居住」之义逐渐占上风，破坏义消失。

items.en: The word spreads from land to lists, forms and digital databases.
items.cn: 这个词从土地扩展到清单、表格与数字数据库。

note.en: Populate is the verb of the Latin people word, so it is built to sit beside populate, population and populous forms, and next to verbs of settling and filling.
note.cn: populate 是拉丁语「人民」的动词形式，因此与 population、populous 等词同族，也与表示「定居」「填满」的动词相邻。

entries.definition: the people who live in a place
entries.definitionCN: 人口；居民

entries.definition: the common people taken as a whole
entries.definitionCN: 平民百姓；民众（名词，来自同一词根）

entries.definition: having many people living in it
entries.definitionCN: 人口稠密的

entries.definition: to live in a place or area
entries.definitionCN: 居住于（强调居住本身，没有填满的含义）

entries.definition: to make a new place your home
entries.definitionCN: 定居；安家（强调落脚定居的动作）

entries.definition: to fill or take up a place, space or position
entries.definitionCN: 占据；占用（强调占位）

normalIntro.en: Populate is the people root made into a verb, and everything it fills, from land to a spreadsheet, is one empty container being filled up.
normalIntro.cn: populate 是把「人民」词根变成动词，它所填充的一切，从土地到电子表格，都是同一个被填满的空容器。

normal.en: The root populus is the people, so populate means to fill a place with people.
normal.cn: 词根 populus 是人民，所以 populate 意为用人口填满一个地方。

normal.en: Densely populated describes land where many people live close together.
normal.cn: densely populated 描述许多人挤在一起的地区。

normal.en: Population and populated share the same stem, so one idea serves all three words.
normal.cn: population 与 populated 共享词干，一个意思支撑三个词。

normal.en: The prefix de- reverses it, so depopulate means to empty a place of people.
normal.cn: 前缀 de- 使意思反转，depopulate 意为使一个地方人丁稀少。

normal.en: In computing a form or database is populated with data, and there nobody actually moves in.
normal.cn: 在计算机领域，表格或数据库被数据填充，此时其实并没有人搬进去。

abstract.en: Picture a blank map slowly filling with tiny lights.
abstract.cn: 想象一张空白地图上慢慢亮起一颗颗小灯。

abstract.en: See a game designer dropping thousands of characters into a new city.
abstract.cn: 想象游戏设计师把成千上万个角色放进一座新城。

abstract.en: Imagine an empty spreadsheet where rows bloom one by one.
abstract.cn: 想象一张空白的电子表格，行一行行地冒出来。

examples.en: The river valley was densely populated in the late nineteenth century.
examples.cn: 这条河谷在十九世纪后期人口稠密。

examples.en: Thousands of birds populate the marsh in winter.
examples.cn: 成千上万只鸟在冬季来到这片沼泽栖息。

examples.en: The app automates the task of populating the survey form.
examples.cn: 这个应用自动完成填写调查表的工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泡普溜」——泡得普普通通，人就一个一个溜进屋把地方住满；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 populus（人民）→ 中世纪拉丁语 populare → 英语 populate（使有人居住），核心是「把人填进一个空间」。

sensesIntro.en: Populate first means to fill a place with people, then to form that population, and finally to fill any container with items or data.
sensesIntro.cn: populate 先指用人口住满一个地方，再指构成那个地方的人口，最后指用物品或数据填充任何容器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an empty space slowly filling with people.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个空荡的空间慢慢被人群填满。

branches.en: Peopling a place is the base verb sense.
branches.cn: 住满一个地方是动词的基本义。

branches.en: Forming the population is the same event seen from the people.
branches.cn: 构成人口是同一事件从人群一方的视角。

branches.en: Filling with data is the technical extension.
branches.cn: 用数据填充是技术领域的延伸义。

branches.en: Settlers populate a valley, and those settlers are its population.
branches.cn: 移民住满山谷，而这些移民就是山谷的人口。

branches.en: Both meanings turn on a container being made full.
branches.cn: 两个意思都围绕一个容器被填满。

intro.en: Populate is the people stem plus a Latin verb ending, and the family spreads across population, populated, depopulate and populous.
intro.cn: populate 是「人民」词干加上拉丁语动词词尾，这一族还扩展到 population、populated、depopulate 与 populous。

latinIntro.en: Latin populus means the people, and latin verbs like populare grew from it into English verbs of settling.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 populus 意为人民，由此发展的拉丁语动词 populare 进入英语，成为表示定居的动词。

items.example: The stem popul opens every word in this family.
items.exampleCN: 词干 popul 开启了这一词族的每个词。

items.meaning: makes a verb, to make or to cause
items.meaningCN: 构成动词的词尾，表示「使……」
items.example: The ending -ate turns the people into a verb.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ate 把「人民」变成动词。

items.meaning: to fill a place with people
items.example: Populate is the core verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: populate 是这一词族的核心动词。

items.meaning: the state or result of an action
items.meaningCN: 表示行为状态或结果的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ion forms population.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ion 构成 population。

items.example: The ending -ed forms populated as an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 使 populated 可作形容词。

items.example: The prefix de- gives depopulate its opposite sense.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 de- 让 depopulate 带上相反含义。

items.meaning: to reduce the people in a place
items.example: Depopulate is the clear opposite of populate.
items.exampleCN: depopulate 是 populate 的明确反义。

items.example: The ending -ous forms populous.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ous 构成 populous。

items.example: The prefix re- forms repopulate, to fill again.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 构成 repopulate，意为再次填充。

latinEntries.example: Populus is the noun behind every form.
latinEntries.exampleCN: populus 是背后支撑所有形式的名词。

latinEntries.meaning: to lay waste, and also to people
latinEntries.example: Populare already carried the peopling sense.
latinEntries.exampleCN: populare 已带「安置居民」的含义。

latinEntries.example: Populatio feeds the English noun population.
latinEntries.exampleCN: populatio 孕育了英语名词 population。
